headline: US Dollar Remains Strong, Foreign Currency Deposits at Banks Sell Well
summary: Foreign-currency deposits at Indonesian banks rose 20.4% year on year through October 2026, as the rupiah weakened against the dollar.
why: Foreign-currency deposits reflect households and firms shifting savings into dollars, which can pressure the rupiah and affect banks' funding structures.
original_headline: Dolar AS Masih Perkasa, Deposito Valas Bank Laris Manis
